# generator-shortcuts

The strongest plausible shortcut is **count each distinct cardinally adjacent marker cell once per chamber**, rather than counting every marker-to-zero cardinal incidence. A marker that wraps around or sits inside a chamber boundary can touch several chamber cells; the intended rule gives it one vote per touch, while this shortcut gives it only one vote total.

It fits all five usable labeled canonical pairs exactly. The source-bound report is `checks/final-shortcut-probe.json` under `canonical_shortcut_fit.distinct_cardinal_marker_cells` (`5/5`).

## Exact disagreement input

This is the generated `full_contrast` input for difficulty `easy`, seed `0`, sample index `0` (18 rows × 14 columns; input SHA-256 `25379d1149a980602d5ee616abec1149f37259b31d2bded7e099f566f9e86cd3`):

```text
55555555555555
55555555335555
55111555000035
55000055000055
52000055000045
55000055000055
55555555000055
55555554445555
55555550000555
55555550000255
55555550000555
55555555555555
55555555555555
55555255555555
55555000555555
55555010555555
55555000555555
55555552555555
```

The final five-row panel contains one color-1 marker touching the same eight-cell zero chamber from four sides, while two separate color-2 markers touch it once each. The intended incidence rule therefore votes `1:4, 2:2` and fills those eight cells with 1. The distinct-marker shortcut votes `1:1, 2:2` and fills them with 2. The outputs differ in exactly eight cells.

The exact JSON input, both outputs, and the Racket receipt are retained under `repo/generators/28cb867ad3f0/counterexamples/review-0593b7fc4490852a/distinct-cardinal-marker-cells/`.

## How the output was checked

I ran the selected canonical Racket rule with the supported `arcpuzzles apply` command. The receipt records generator SHA-256 `402c0cb6bc5f73f1cbd70a739f4792dd4e1f398c27e239b383a7a9cfc4977324`, executed/catalog rule hash `56654a66f781`, and a valid output. That output exactly matches the independent Python incidence mirror and differs from the shortcut output in eight cells; see `evidence.json` and `racket.json` in the counterexample directory.

## Does the proposed generator emit it?

Yes. `full_contrast` is emitted at every even sample index in the ordinary 18-step schedule. In the retained finite probe over sample indices 0..35, the shortcut disagreed on 18/36 draws in each of easy, medium, and hard. Every consecutive four-pair lesson therefore contains two such profiles, and after any single query holdout at least one remains among the three demonstrations.
